summary: E2E regression on Super Admin → Messaggi letture tracking. Backend pytest suite (5/5 PASSED) covers list recipients/read, stats shape, read-flow increment, idempotency and superadmin-preview non-counting + delete purge. UI Playwright test confirms the whole flow: superadmin login → create message (recipients_mode=all) → initial '0/N' in Letture column → open stats dialog (summary 'N destinatari · 0 letti · N non letto', per-user rows with Organizzazione/Utente/Email/Stato/Data lettura) → brand-new org admin reads via Dashboard banner ('Segna come letto') → polling+focus refetch bumps column to '1/N' → stats dialog shows '1 letti · (N-1) non letto' with that user flagged 'Letto'. Idempotency and superadmin-preview (X-Org-Id) non-counting also verified via API. Behaviour fully matches the spec.
critical_code_review_comments: PlatformMessages.jsx uses the same data-testid pattern 'msg-stats-state-<user_id>' for both 'Letto' and 'Non letto' badges. Since 'Letto' is a substring of 'Non letto', text-based selectors must use exact-match. Consider using distinct test-ids (e.g., msg-stats-state-letto-<uid> / -nonletto-<uid>) or a data-state attribute to make automated selection unambiguous.

Recipients count for recipients_mode='all' is computed at read-time from current memberships, so creating a new org after publishing a message increases the denominator. This is the correct product behaviour (future orgs are included), but worth documenting; the test harness pre-registered the org before publishing to keep denominators stable.

GET /api/platform/messages performs an N×2 Mongo distinct per message (recipients + reads) inside a Python loop — fine for current volumes but a candidate for aggregation if the list grows (>500 msgs or >100 orgs).
Frontend polling (45s list + 20s stats) + window focus listener works as expected; no WebSocket introduced, aligned with the request.

success_rate.frontend: 100% functional (one assertion was a selector-substring issue in the test, not a UI defect; verified via summary text)

Note: register-organization requires telefono with international prefix (+39...). Superadmin's /my/messages/* endpoints require X-Org-Id header (otherwise 428). The 'msg-stats-state-<uid>' selector collides with 'Non letto' text; use exact=True or distinct ids when writing new Playwright tests.
rca of the issue: N/A — the fix in this iteration (dedup read docs per (message_id,user_id), scope reads/recipients to target orgs via distinct('user_id'), per-user rows in stats, polling+focus refetch, preview short-circuit in /my/messages/{mid}/read when user.role=='superadmin') is working correctly end-to-end.
